scope: public explicit-camera single-image novel-view backbones for Stage 1.8

candidates.name: GenWarp
candidates.reason: single target image API directly consumes source RGB, source depth and explicit source/target camera matrices; multi2 was trained across RE10K, ACID, ScanNet and MegaScene
candidates.risk: official repository reports A100 testing but no memory figure; 16 GiB feasibility must be established by a one-target smoke before any val batch

candidates.name: ViewCrafter_25_512
candidates.reason: official 320x512 variant reports 13.8 GB on A100, but produces a 25-frame video and leaves little headroom on a shared 16 GiB card; retain as fallback

candidates.name: Stable Virtual Camera v1.1
candidates.reason: strong explicit-camera generalist, but 1.3B gated weights require Hugging Face authentication and outputs remain non-commercial; memory feasibility is not officially bounded for 16 GiB

candidates.name: MetaView
candidates.reason: explicit yaw/pitch and scale-aware geometry are relevant, but the released stack requires Qwen-Image-Edit plus two Depth Anything 3 giant models and is not a minimal 16 GiB first candidate

integration_boundary.visible_warp_and_support: GenWarp warped image, mask and correspondence
integration_boundary.depth: existing frozen RGB-only depth provider applied to synthesized target RGB; target depth truth remains evaluator-only
integration_boundary.first_gate: one qualified val target runtime/memory/finite-output smoke
integration_boundary.next_gate: all 14 qualified val targets under the frozen Stage 1.8 region metrics

decision: install GenWarp in an isolated environment, download only multi2 and mandatory shared components, then run a one-target 16 GiB feasibility smoke
